jobPostingInfo.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You will own the automation platform underneath VLSI infrastructure - the tooling, services and pipelines that turn manual infrastructure work into something that runs itself


What you'll be doing:

  • In this position, you will own the automation platform underneath VLSI infrastructure - the tooling, services and pipelines that turn manual infrastructure work into something that runs itself.
  • Design and build internal services and command-line tooling used daily by design and infrastructure engineers, with real attention to interface design and reliability.
  • Build event-driven automation around source control - reacting to repository events, keeping workspaces and client mappings healthy, and removing the manual maintenance around them.
  • Own CI, release and deployment mechanics for the team's internal tooling, and instrument what you build so it is observable and debuggable by the rest of the team.
  • This is a hands-on technical role. You will write and run the code yourself, work with the scheduling team on the automation layer beneath job submission, and reduce the operational load on senior engineers by turning their recurring manual work into services.

What we need to see:

  • B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure software engineering.
  • Strong software engineering in Python - you write production-quality, tested code rather than one-off scripts, and you have delivered tooling that other engineers depend on daily.
  • Hands-on experience automating against source control management at scale, Perforce preferred and Git acceptable, including its APIs and event streams.
  • Solid CI/CD experience (GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent) and container-based packaging and deployment.
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge and shell fluency, with experience building and operating internal developer platforms or engineering tooling.
  • Familiarity with batch compute environments and how engineering workloads are submitted, tracked and debugged, and comfort owning what you build in production. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC exposure is a plus.

jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Storage Management Platform - DGX Cloud
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to become part of our storage management plane team. The management plane is a web-based application crafted to provide our storage customers the capabilities to handle and supervise our distributed storage infrastructure. Our team is continually dedicated to acquiring and implementing ground breaking technologies to overcome obstacles and innovate solutions for improving our ability to handle large clusters of machines efficiently.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Maintain and develop Kubernetes operators and our Container Storage Interface (CSI) plugin.

  • Develop a web-based solution that manages, operates and monitors our distributed storage.

  • Work closely with other teams to define and implement new APIs.

What We Need to See:

  • B.Sc., M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in web development (both client and server)

  • Proven experience with Kubernetes (K8s), including developing or maintaining operators and/or CSI plugins.

  • Experience scripting with Python, Bash or similar. Experience with nodejs is a must

  • At least 5 years of experience working in a Linux OS environment

  • You’re smart and a quick learner

  • You do what it takes to get the job done

  • Passionate about coding and big challenges

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • NodeJS for the server side: dominant modules are async & express. Kafka, MongoDB, K8s

  • JavaScript frameworks: React, jQuery, c3j

  • HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap and Websockets; Scripting (Python and Bash) as well as Git and Linux

NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. This is our life’s work — to amplify human imagination and intelligence.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to extraordinary growth, our elite engineering teams are fast-growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous manager with a sincere real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 17, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
